texts.li: {A_nameDef} stood very still while {X_indefinite} settled on the fence beside {A_objective}, its wings opening and closing like slow breathing.
On the way back from the fields, {A_nameDef} walked into a cloud of color: {X_indefinite}, drifting from flower to flower, unbothered.
[x:race:AA_AuroraSylph] After dark, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} hang above the field like a curtain of green light, and didn't go in until it faded.
[x:race:AA_EmpressButterfly] Where {X_definite} had passed, every flower in the bed seemed to stand a little straighter. {A_nameDef} swears it wasn't imagination.
[child] {A_nameDef} chased {X_definite} across the yard and never caught it, which was the point.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} go past at a dead run, faster than any horse, and found one of its feathers in the grass afterwards, longer than {A_possessive} arm.
{A_nameDef} came over the rise and nearly walked into {X_indefinite}. They looked at each other for a long moment; then the bird snapped its beak once and strolled off.
[x:race:AA_RoyalAve] {A_nameDef} found a plume from {X_definite} caught on a bush, so bright it looked dyed. It's pinned over {A_possessive} bed now.
[x:race:AA_FrostAve] Against the wind, {X_definite} fluffed itself up until it was twice its size, and {A_nameDef} laughed out loud.
[skill:Animals] {A_nameDef} spent the afternoon watching how {X_definite} moves and eats, and has decided the colony should own one.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} graze its way along the edge of the fields, unhurried, as if the colony were a strange kind of rock.
[x:race:AA_Thunderox] Out in the pasture, {X_definite} lifted its head and bellowed. {A_nameDef} has heard the old saying, and started bringing the washing in. The storm came an hour later.
[x:race:AA_ChameleonYak] {A_nameDef} lost sight of {X_definite} against the hillside three times in one afternoon. Its coat had gone the color of the grass.
[x:race:AA_Radyak] The crystals along the back of {X_definite} caught the evening light, and {A_nameDef} stood watching until it moved on.
[x:race:AA_GreyCoatedMouflon] Standing near {X_definite}, {A_nameDef} felt oddly calm, as if someone had taken a weight off {A_possessive} shoulders. It lasted until the animal wandered off.
[x:race:AA_Gigantelope] Past the wall walked {X_indefinite}, its head higher than the roof. {A_nameDef} worked out how much it could carry, and sighed.
{A_nameDef} spent a good while watching {X_indefinite} drag its rock across the yard, one patient sideways step at a time.
[x:race:AA_PebbleMit] Wherever {X_definite} went, it left a trail of loose stone, and {A_nameDef} followed it round collecting the pieces for the builders.
[x:race:AA_CrystalMit] {A_nameDef} caught {X_definite} eating the gravel off the path and couldn't decide whether to be annoyed or impressed.
[x:race:AA_SummitCrab] Something the size of a hill moved at the edge of the map. It was {X_indefinite}, carrying what looked like half a mountain. {A_nameDef} didn't go any closer.
[child] {A_nameDef} sat on a rock for ten minutes before the rock got up and walked away. It was {X_indefinite}.
{A_nameDef} looked up from {A_possessive} work and saw {X_indefinite} drifting overhead, quite slowly, as if it had all the time in the world.

[x:race:AA_ColossalAerofleet] With a soft thump, {X_indefinite} bounced off the colony's wall, turned, bounced off it again, and floated away. {A_nameDef} watched the whole thing with {A_possessive} mouth open.
[x:race:AA_Skyeel] With a faint crackle, {X_definite} flicked past {A_nameDef} through the air, and the hairs on {A_possessive} arms stood up.
[child] {A_nameDef} tried to throw a pebble over {X_definite}. It went under.
Crossing the yard after dark, {A_nameDef} saw a pair of eyes watching from the edge of the light. It was {X_indefinite}, and it didn't move until {A_pronoun} did.
[x:race:AA_DuskRat] Four small eyes glowed at {A_nameDef} from under the storeroom door. {A_nameDef} has counted them twice and it is definitely four.
[x:race:AA_NightRam] Once the sun was gone, {X_definite} came down to graze, and {A_nameDef} sat on the wall and watched it, both of them quiet.
[x:race:AA_CrepuscularBeetle] In the dark, {X_definite} trundled past the colony like a cart with no driver. {A_nameDef} stepped aside to let it by.

The ground shook, and {A_nameDef} looked up to see {X_indefinite} walking past the colony, taller than anything the colony has ever built. {A_nameDef} put down {A_possessive} tools and watched until it was gone.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_definite} from the wall until it was only a shape on the horizon. Afterwards {A_pronoun} couldn't say how long it had taken.
Out on the mudflats, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} pick its way between ribs as tall as trees, the bones of something that came here to die long ago.
{A_nameDef} found {X_indefinite} sheltering from the sun in the hollow of an enormous skull, and left it in peace.
{A_nameDef} lay in the grass under the giant flowers and watched {X_indefinite} graze nearby, close enough to hear it chewing.
From between flower stalks as thick as {A_nameDef}'s waist came {X_indefinite}, dusted yellow with pollen. It sneezed.
{A_nameDef} ducked under a mushroom cap the size of a roof to get out of the rain, and found {X_indefinite} had had the same idea.
In the green half-light under the giant mushrooms, {A_nameDef} watched {X_indefinite} nose through the spores on the ground. Both of them sneezed.
{A_nameDef} saw {X_indefinite} freeze among the trees, ears up. A dozen eyes on the nearest trunk had turned to look at it. Then they turned to look at {A_nameDef}.
Every time the eyes in the bark blinked, {X_definite} flinched, and so did {A_nameDef}. Neither of them stayed long.
